title: Readable blog article page
when: The user wants a single article or blog post page, or a template for posts.
inputs: article text with images or code
prompt:
Goal: A comfortable long form reading page with good typography and clear structure.
Steps:
1. Article element with h1 title, byline, time element and reading time.
2. Body column about 65 characters wide, line height 1.6, paragraphs with space between.
3. Subheadings every few paragraphs; figures with figcaption for images.
4. Quotes in blockquote, code in pre and code with horizontal scroll inside the block only.
5. End with author box, related posts and a link back to the blog.
Quality bar:
- Readable at 375 px without zoom.
- Images scale to the column width.
- Meta description and og tags summarize the post.
Pitfalls:
- Code blocks that make the whole page scroll sideways.
- Light gray body text.
- Sticky bars that cover a third of a phone screen.
Verify:
- [ ] One h1, h2 sections without skipped levels.
- [ ] Images have alt and figcaption where useful.
- [ ] Meta description present.
- [ ] Contrast passes.
Output: post.html (or the page asked for) and article styles in style.css.

examples.input: article page for my post about composting
examples.output: h1, byline with date, 4 h2 sections, a figure with caption, related posts
